subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no.2.
solution:
The solution is **highest**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate option to fill in blank no.2 " It was fitted on top of the (2)_______ hill of Venice." is highest.
 
• It was fitted on top of the highest hill of Venice.
 
• Superlative degrees are, *for example, Good, Better, Best.*
 
• Therefore **option 3 **is the correct option.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The options given above are the superlative degree of **high**.
